description: A Dockerfile that builds in one stage and copies only the result into a small runtime stage, so the API runtime needs no Maven or source files.
An optional service grouping, here used to start the API only when the full profile is enabled.
A depends_on condition of service_healthy that holds the API back until the database healthcheck passes.
A .env file with local values that stays out of Git, paired with a committed .env.example that holds fake values.
The Actuator health, liveness and readiness paths a platform calls to decide on restarts and traffic.
A YAML file under .github/workflows that builds and tests the API with read-only permissions and pinned actions.
Checks with fixed test data, such as exact curl commands and expected output, that decide whether the project is done.
